company.description: Source Beauty is an informed beauty e-commerce platform that seeks out the best skincare, makeup, fragrances, and health products in the market and acts as a hub of information for the Egyptian female. Source Beauty began as a blog where the hunt for the coolest beauty products were shared on a social media platform. Our mission is to decode the often intimidating beauty world which leaves people in a state of confusion. The aim of Source Beauty is to inspire you to nourish,  enhance, and make the right beauty choices for the best version of you.
